correctness.rationale: The nonzero equilibria follow algebraically from the four stationarity equations. Exact determinant expansion gives the displayed quartic. Its Routh--Hurwitz determinants are \(\Delta_2=(243-4q)/2\) and \(\Delta_3=-(3/4)(48q^2-1528q-1377)\). Their signs give stability up to the unique positive \(\Delta_3\) root. At equality the quartic factors into one simple imaginary pair and a Hurwitz quadratic; beyond it the Routh first-column sign changes give exactly two right-half-plane roots, with the isolated \(\Delta_2=0\) point handled by absence of imaginary-axis roots there. The bundled standard-library replay reconstructs these identities exactly. No global-attractor or nonlinear-Hopf conclusion is asserted.
